name: Sakuma Kazuko
source:
A 40 year old housewife who runs a fruits and vegetables store in the shopping district of town.

She is a mother of two and her second son is a classmate of Kouta's. She treats Kouta as if he were her own child.

She is a good adviser to the other members of the "Mom's Club.

Jun seems to have a hard time with her...

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mama-club2.html]official site[/url]]
